home.subtitle: Run your Sunday game without chasing anyone: sign-ups with a waitlist, check-in at the pitch, balanced teams, fees and everyone's reliability.
home.emptyBody: A group is your regular game: the pitch, the day, the players. Create it, then send the invite link on WhatsApp.
home.noNext: You are not signed up for any game yet. Open a group to see its next games.
home.joinBody: Did the organiser give you a six-character code? Type it here.
home.joinNotFound: No group with this code on this device. For now, a group lives on the phone that created it: invites between phones will come with accounts.
home.honestBody: Today, your groups live on this device. Invites shared between phones, notifications and real Mobile Money payments need accounts: they are on the roadmap. Until then, the organiser keeps the list for the whole group and shares the link on WhatsApp.

plan.title: Organiser plan
plan.players: Players always play for free. The organiser tools are paid, with a free trial.

unlock.payments: Fee tracking: MTN MoMo, Orange Money, cash, who paid and who owes.
unlock.season: The season summary per player (attendance, no-shows, late arrivals, money) and the CSV export.
unlock.teams: Automatically balanced teams and the drag-and-drop board.

plan.demoNote: Payments are not connected yet: the trial and the plan are a demonstration on this device, nothing is billed.
plan.gateBody: Try it free for {{days}} days, then {{month}} per month. Players always play for free.
plan.gateExpired: Your trial has ended. Choose the monthly or yearly plan to continue.

form.name: Group name
form.nameHint: The name everyone recognises, for example the day and the neighbourhood.
form.positionHint: Optional. Do it once at the pitch: the location check-in will accept players within {{m}} m.
form.geoError: Location unavailable. Allow location in the browser, or leave this empty.
form.geoUnsupported: This browser does not give a location.
form.minTierHint: Below this tier, signing up becomes a request that you approve.
form.payHint: Players will see these numbers and a game code to put in the transfer note.

newGame.title: New game
newGame.deadlineHint: After this time, players can no longer sign themselves up. You can still add someone.

invite.title: Invite players
invite.honest: You send the message yourself. For now, the link opens the group on this device; invites between phones will come with accounts.
invite.text: Hi! Join “{{name}}” on Ndamba ({{venue}}{{when}}). Sign up here: {{url}} (code {{code}})

group.notFoundBody: This group does not exist on this device, or it was deleted.
group.notMember: You are not part of this group on this device.
group.noPast: Played games will appear here with their score.

game.notFoundBody: This game does not exist on this device, or it was deleted.
game.notMember: You are not part of this group on this device.
game.afterLine: Check-in is closed. Enter the score in the Teams tab; players who did not show up without notice got a flag.

me.belowTier: This group asks for the {{tier}} tier: the organiser approves your request.
me.offered: A spot is offered to you until {{time}}.
me.suspended: Your sign-ups are blocked: {{max}} no-shows in {{days}} days. The organiser can lift the suspension.

msg.waitlist: The game is full: you are on the waitlist. If a spot opens up, it will be offered to you.
msg.pending: Request sent: the organiser has to approve it.
msg.deadline: Sign-ups are closed for this game.
msg.suspended: You cannot sign up: suspension in progress.
msg.closed: This game no longer takes sign-ups.
msg.already: You are already on the list.
msg.left: Drop-out recorded. Thanks for letting everyone know.
msg.guestGoing: Guest added: they have a spot.
msg.guestWaitlist: Guest added at the end of the waitlist.

admin.waitlist: Game full: player added to the waitlist.
admin.suspended: This player is suspended: lift the suspension from their card first.
admin.closed: This game no longer takes sign-ups.
admin.already: This player is already on the list.

checkin.opensAt: Check-in opens at {{time}}. At the pitch, tap “I'm here” (within {{m}} m of the pitch if its location is saved).
checkin.far: You are {{dist}} from the pitch (maximum {{max}} m). Get closer, or ask the organiser to check you in.
checkin.geoError: Location unavailable. Ask the organiser to check you in.
checkin.noGeo: This browser does not give a location. Ask the organiser to check you in.
checkin.adminLine: Check-in open until {{time}}: {{n}} of {{total}} checked in. Tap “Check in” for anyone who could not do it.

offer.expired: {{name}}'s window has passed ({{time}}): confirm their spot or pass it on.

players.addBody: Add a member who replied by message. The cap and the waitlist apply; the deadline does not.
players.allIn: Every member is already on the list.
players.waitRule: When a spot opens up, it is offered to the first person on the list for {{m}} minutes. A guest never jumps the queue.

guest.title: Bring a guest
guest.body: Your guest takes a real spot, under your name (and so does their fee). If the game is full, they go to the end of the waitlist.
guest.name: Guest's first name

teams.help: Drag a player from one team to the other, or tap one player in each team, then “Swap”. Each player's strength comes from their average rating and tier.
teams.notYet: The organiser will pick the teams at the pitch.

score.title: Game score
score.afterKickoff: The score can be entered from kick-off.
score.noTeams: Without saved teams, this score will not count in wins, draws and losses.

pay.privacy: Only the organisers see who paid. Here you see your own fee.
pay.step1: Send {{amount}} to {{name}}, the organiser, on this number:
pay.step2: In the transfer note, write this game code:
pay.step3: The organiser ticks your payment when it arrives.
pay.cash: Cash accepted at the pitch, handed to the organiser.
pay.honest: Ndamba never touches the money: the transfer happens in your Mobile Money app. In-app payments will come with accounts.

rate.notYet: Ratings open once the organiser has saved the score.
rate.cannot: Only players who checked in rate their teammates from this game.
rate.title: Rate your teammates
rate.body: From 1 to 5, for this game. It is anonymous: nobody sees who gave which rating.

rules.title: How tiers are calculated
rules.anonymous: Ratings are anonymous and pooled: an average only counts from {{min}} ratings received.
rules.withAvg: {{games}} games played or more, and an average of {{avg}} or more.
rules.played: A game played is a game where the player checked in. Until the average counts, the tier stops at bronze.
rules.reliability: Reliability: 70% attendance (showing up when signed up) and 30% punctuality (checking in less than {{late}} minutes after kick-off).

card.title: Player card
card.noGames: No finished game yet: reliability is calculated after the first one.
card.ratingPending: {{n}} of the {{min}} ratings needed: the average will count from {{min}}.
card.ratingLine: Average rating: {{avg}} out of 5 ({{count}} anonymous ratings).

next.silver: Next tier, silver: {{games}} games played and a {{avg}} average.
next.gold: Next tier, gold: {{games}} games played and a {{avg}} average.

flags.suspendedBody: {{max}} no-shows in {{days}} days: sign-ups are blocked.

members.intro: Tap a player to see their card: tier, wins, reliability and recent games.

member.name: Name
member.nicknameHint: The name shouted on the pitch. By default, the first name.
member.phoneHint: Optional, to find them on WhatsApp.

season.note: Guests' fees count for the player who brought them. Waived spots count neither as paid nor as owed.

settings.title: Group settings
settings.ratingsYes: Teammates rate each other after every game.
settings.coadminsBody: Open a member's card to make them a co-organiser (three at most, with the organiser plan).
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” with its games, players and history? This cannot be undone.
settings.leaveConfirm: Leave this group? Your sign-ups for the next games will be cancelled.

join.label: Invite to a pickup game
join.free: Playing is always free. Your spot is confirmed in one tap, and the organiser sees who is coming.
join.unknownTitle: An invite is waiting for you
join.unknownBody: This link comes from an organiser who uses Ndamba. For now, a group lives on its organiser's phone, and this group is not on this device.
join.roadmap: Invites between phones, notifications and in-app payments will come with accounts. Until then, reply to the organiser on WhatsApp: they will add you to their list.
